overviewHtml:
CI/CD data is scattered across providers, which makes slow or failing pipelines hard to diagnose. This app unifies pipelines, jobs, stages and PRs from Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and GitLab in one Dynatrace app — including a flamegraph of pipeline execution and a wizard that installs the OpenPipeline rules for you.

What you get

  • Pipeline view with status, total time, history, and recent runs
  • Stage and job view with duration, outcome, and metadata
  • Pipeline execution flamegraph
  • Setup wizard for OpenPipeline rules and custom providers via HTTP events
setupHtml:
CI/CD Observability is available as a Dynatrace app to all customers upon request. It is delivered via a Hub subscription.

  1. Email community-apps@dynatrace.com with your account name and tenant ID.
  2. We'll process your request and send instructions for subscribing to the channel and installing the app.
  3. After installation, open the app and navigate to the Setup tab to find your target technology. Follow the instructions to set up the webhooks on the chosen provider.
  4. Select Import Configuration to import the OpenPipeline rules to your environment. Those rules translate the incoming webhook events into SDLC events (OpenTelemetry standard), which are then consumed by the app.
  1. Start exploring the data.

Note: Filters are only applied after clicking the refresh button to avoid unnecessary queries.
getStartedHtml:
1. Request the Hub subscription by emailing the community apps team
  2. Install the app and open its Setup tab
  3. Configure webhooks on your provider and import the OpenPipeline rules
